pause_response.module: Module 1 — Customer discovery and problem decomposition
pause_response.scenario: A commercial refrigeration services company’s COO tells you: “Emergency jobs are missing their four-hour SLA, and we’re losing renewals. Build us an AI dispatch system that predicts breaches and automatically reassigns technicians. I need a pilot in eight weeks.”
pause_response.current_question: You are leading the first 45-minute customer meeting. What do you do first?
competencies_in_scope: Requirements clarification, discovery, ambiguous problem decomposition
Stakeholder communication, prioritization and measurable business outcomes
System design, architectural defense, scalability and cost
SQL, relational reasoning, data modeling, query performance
